verdict.rationale: Consensus serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) plus llms-full.txt and a .well-known/pricing.md, which give an agent a machine-readable entry point covering the product, its features, filters, and the REST/MCP surface. The agent-oriented doc set is incomplete, though: per-page markdown docs return 404, docs.consensus.app is Cloudflare-walled, and the OpenAPI spec linked from llms.txt points to a host failing TLS. missing for 10: reachable agent-readable developer docs, a working machine-readable OpenAPI contract linked from llms.txt, markdown versions of doc pages, independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Power agent workflows that need citable scientific sources via the REST API or MCP server
API and agent ready: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app
The developer docs site (docs.consensus.app) is Cloudflare-walled throughout.
